failure_modes.name: Query_Stagnation
failure_modes.evidence: Query at hop 2: 'What is the relationship between the 2002 Telugu film "Neetho" starring Mahek Chahal and the 2005 Tamil film "Sachein"?' Query at hop 3: 'Mahek Chahal, Neetho film, Sachein film' — Both queries target the same three entities (Mahek Chahal, Neetho, Sachein) already fully covered in hop 1. Retrieval results at hop 2 and hop 3 return identical or near-identical documents to hop 1 (Neetho, Sachein, Mahek Chahal passages repeated across all three hops).

failure_modes.evidence: Query at hop 2: 'What is the relationship between the 2002 Telugu film "Neetho" starring Mahek Chahal and the 2005 Tamil film "Sachein"?' — This is formulated as a natural-language question asking about a relationship, rather than entity names or simple phrases the retriever can target.
